# JULIUS: ORCHID TAXONOMY MATCHING PROJECT

## MISSION
I need you to fetch scientific names for 13,429 orchid species from Encyclopedia of Life (EOL).

## YOUR TASK
For each EOL page ID below, visit https://eol.org/pages/{PAGE_ID} and extract:
- Scientific name (e.g., "Aa achalensis")
- Genus (first word: "Aa")
- Species (remaining words: "achalensis")

## OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a CSV file called: julius_taxonomy_results.csv

Columns: eol_page_id,scientific_name,genus,species,family

Example rows:
1000464,Aa achalensis,Aa,achalensis,Orchidaceae
1000822,Cattleya labiata,Cattleya,labiata,Orchidaceae
